= Native web component libraries

Component libraries built on native web components, usable with any framework or
none at all.

* https://www.webcomponents.org/[WebComponents.org]
* https://www.duetds.com/[Duet]
* https://www.fast.design/[FAST (from Microsoft)]
* https://kelpui.com/[Kelp]
* https://kickstand-ui.com/[Kickstand UI]
* https://github.com/material-components/material-web[Material Design Web Components (deprecated)]
* https://shoelace.style/[Shoelace]
* https://github.com/adobe/spectrum-web-components[Spectrum Web Components (Adobe)]
* https://github.com/andreasbm/weightless[Weightless]
* https://carbondesignsystem.com/[Carbon (IBM's Design System)]
* https://www.blazeui.com/[Blaze]
* https://amp.dev/[AMP]
* https://baklava.design/[Baklava]
* https://onsen.io/[Onsen UI]
